statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is constructed by combining the four distinct non-cash expense line items from the primary consolidated cash flow statement that represent depreciation, amortization, and impairment losses. These are: 1) Depreciation and amortization of, and impairment losses on, intangible assets, property, plant and equipment, and investment property; 2) Amortization of and impairment losses on capitalized development costs; 3) Impairment losses on equity investments; and 4) Depreciation of and impairment losses on lease assets. This aggregation aligns with standard practice for calculating total depreciation and amortization in cash flow statements. All values are in millions of Euros (scale: 1E6). The supplementary tables provide divisional and business area breakdowns but do not alter the composition of the consolidated field.
